title: Project work item
description: The top work-item altitude (portfolio ADR-0015): a goal in executive terms, verified by Measure. The BODY is the contract — goal and verification prose live there and are what the approval hash pins; frontmatter is state and may change through conduit's doors without breaking the seal. Sign-off (status draft -> ready) is a human seat; close (-> done) is the same seat, with every child story terminal.

id.description: Stable opaque page identifier (ULID, tool-generated). Links target this, not the path.

status.description: Work-item lifecycle, aligned to conduit workitem::Status (transitions enforced by conduit's doors)

created.description: RFC 3339 timestamp the project was created

implements.description: Ids/slugs of the accepted decision pages this project implements — the provenance edge Measure walks from priced work back to the decision

repo.description: The internal bare repo this project's work lands in (one repo per project for now; stories and tasks inherit it)

by.description: The human seat that signed off the goal

content_sha256.description: sha256 of the page body exactly as signed — any body edit breaks it and bounces the item to draft. Written only by conduit's sign-off door, never by the harness (suite convention, portfolio ADR-0015).

approval.description: Sign-off seal. Its presence is what makes an item executable; only the owning door writes it.

x-wiki-types.project: Work-item project: an executive-altitude goal, Measure-verified
